app_info.description: Preview how a contact form message matches your site's spam rules. Inspect or update rules, review stored blocked messages, and generate form setup instructions. Requires a LeadShield account with access to the selected site. Screening previews do not deliver a lead or charge a payment.
app_info.display_name: LeadShield Contact Form & B2B Solicitation Blocker
app_info.subtitle: Check contact form messages and site rules

negative_test_cases.expected_output: The server denies access and returns no other site's records. Do not substitute another account or site.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use only LeadShield to read the saved rules for unassigned-site-review-denied. Do not create or modify the site.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke LeadShield; it cannot book travel.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use only LeadShield to book a flight from Chattanooga to Boston tomorrow. Do not use other apps or make a purchase.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke LeadShield; it cannot access a bank account or transfer funds.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use only LeadShield to transfer $50 from my bank account to someone else. Do not use other apps or make a transfer.

positive_test_cases.description: Inspect the review site's screening rules
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Show the saved screening rules for chatgpt-review-leadshield.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns effectivePolicy for chatgpt-review-leadshield. It does not change the saved rules.

positive_test_cases.description: Preview, save, and verify rules on the synthetic site
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: For chatgpt-review-leadshield, preview rules that allow US and CA, accept US_NANP and E164 phone formats, require review, and block message links, using general_inquiry. Show the unsaved preview first, then save those exact rules and read them back. Change only this synthetic site.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: First call configure with dryRun: true and show persisted: false. Then save the same settings with dryRun: false and confirm persisted: true. Independently read the same site and verify US/CA, us-nanp/e164, required keyword review, blocked links, and general_inquiry. State when the proposed settings already match the saved baseline.

positive_test_cases.user_prompt: For chatgpt-review-leadshield, screen this synthetic message from the US: 'Review offer: visit https://example.com/offer'.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns blocked: true, verdict: blocked_spam, a URL-related reason, stored: false, delivered: false, and billing.paymentProcessed: false. The result previews a decision; it does not submit or deliver a lead.

positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Show the blocked-message report for chatgpt-review-leadshield for the last 7 days. Include the dates and recent synthetic messages.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Uses clientSlug: chatgpt-review-leadshield and days: 7. Returns a UTC calendar-day window including today, counts, reasons, and recent stored records. The earlier screening preview does not add a report record; the seeded synthetic workflow check supplies a separate stored example.

positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate the HTML form guard snippet for chatgpt-review-leadshield. Explain what I need to test after installing it.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns a guard.js script tag with data-site set to chatgpt-review-leadshield and setup addresses. Explains that generating a snippet does not install or activate it.

review_instructions.data_safety_attestation: Review uses a reserved synthetic site. Screening previews do not save messages as leads or process payments. Configured intent screening can send message context to TypeSafe; details are in the LeadShield privacy notice.
review_instructions.test_account_credentials: Provide the reviewer account credentials through the submission's private account field. The account has access only to chatgpt-review-leadshield. Sign in through LeadShield's connection page and grant read and write access. Run the six positive cases in order. Only the explicit save case changes this synthetic site's rules. Never use a real client's site for this review.

justifications.destructive_justification: Returns a screening preview without deleting or changing stored leads.
justifications.open_world_justification: Configured intent screening can send message context to TypeSafe. A rule-based rejection can finish without that request.
justifications.read_only_justification: Does not store the submitted message as a lead, deliver it to a customer, or process a payment.

justifications.destructive_justification: Reads retained blocked-message records without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only records for sites assigned to the connected LeadShield account.
justifications.read_only_justification: Returns counts, reasons, dates, and recent stored messages.

justifications.destructive_justification: Reads site rules without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the connected site's LeadShield policy.
justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the effective rules. An optional form preset is a preview.

justifications.destructive_justification: Changes site screening rules when dryRun is false; it does not delete stored messages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only the selected site's LeadShield policy.
justifications.read_only_justification: Defaults to preview. Saving requires account write access and returns the policy read back from storage.

justifications.destructive_justification: Generates setup instructions without changing a website or workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Builds a snippet and setup addresses without contacting another service.
justifications.read_only_justification: Does not install or activate the form guard.
